why: A package function is reached by its full name, `pkg.util(x)`, even from a file of its own package (MATLAB doc 'Namespaces' / 'Packages Create Namespaces'; the case packages/full-name-only-even-inside), and a local function only by its bare name from its own file (doc 'Local Functions', 'Function Precedence Order'; matlab-lookup.ts). So once `+pkg/util.m` is deleted, turned to Octave (step 4: Octave is not read) or turned to Objective-C text, `pkg.util(x)` in `+pkg/tool.m` links nowhere, though `tool.m` has a local `util`, and it links to `+pkg/util.m` again once that is back. Each step must end where a fresh index ends (project rule).
